data.title: 斯卡蒂 · 潮汐归夜的灯塔低吟
data.action: 赤足坐于栈桥木桩，重剑插在身侧木板，回眸凝视
data.location: 伊比利亚废弃灯塔木栈桥
data.lighting: 海上冷月勾亮发丝与飞沫，旧灯塔的一格残灯在背后留下微弱暖点
data.description: 伊比利亚废弃灯塔旁的临海旧木栈桥上，狂风吹散了夜雾。斯卡蒂赤足坐在微凉的木桩上，巨大重剑插在身旁木板之中，双腿轻垂在拍岸的白色浪沫上方。她微微回首，绯红眼眸褪去了白日的杀伐，在冰凉海风与澄澈月色下多了一分只对博士流露的温软。
data.promptProse: The pier boards draw the eye from the planted greatsword to Skadi on the broad end of a piling. She turns back over her shoulder with her legs hanging over the sea and her silver hair streaming along the pier. Below the dry deck, white water breaks against a line of dark rocks. Moonlight outlines her hair and picks out the rope wound round the nearest timber. Beyond the spray, the old Iberian lighthouse stands on the headland with a faint amber light leaking through one window.
data.animaCaption: Seated sideways on the wide end of a pier piling, she turns her head toward the viewer as her bare feet hang just above the waves. Her greatsword stands in the planks at her side, framed against the old lighthouse on the bluff.
data.nsfwProse: She is in her dark navy and black layered strappy lingerie set with a small silver fishbone clasp and narrow cross-back straps.
